'''Kit Valent''' was a [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served as [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca's]] gunner during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="Inside" />

==Biography==
Valent grew up around a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on his homeworld of [[Huulia/Legends|Huulia]]. There, he hired on to various [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and [[Transport/Legends|transports]] as a teenager to see the galaxy. This convinced him that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] needed to be overthrown.<ref name="TEGW" />

After joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], Valent was assigned to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. As [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] on Zev Senesca's [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]], designated [[Rogue Two/Legends|Rogue Two]], he took part in the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="Inside" /> Both Senesca and Valent were killed when their speeder was destroyed by an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]].<ref name="SW5">{{Film|V}}</ref>
